sources.finding: New mobile app/update submissions require target API36+ from 31 August 2026; the project and decoded installed preview target37. Final signed artifact must be checked separately.

Non-accessibility-tool use requires prominent in-app disclosure, affirmative consent and declaration review. Deterministic narrow automation is permitted within stated constraints; autonomous decision/action functionality is prohibited. Reviewer video must show launch, complete disclosure, consent/grant, refusal/re-entry, and the core accessibility feature.

Data safety must cover app and third-party behavior. Collection means off-device transmission; external-backup exception requires the app never access the data. Because this app constructs history backups, that exception is not assumed. Match actual transport, final implementation and privacy notice.

candidateReviewItems: Demonstrate the complete prominent accessibility disclosure and both consent/refusal routes in a synthetic reviewer video; do not record private feed/history or parent secrets

State that installation-local PIN/recovery/biometric authority is excluded from backups; restored restrictions must not claim restored parent authority
Keep Facebook auto-scroll unavailable limitations truthful and nonblocking under ADR-110; no universal source or playback claim
